pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Explore the Underworld dungeon and obtain its normal key. No additional campaign gatekeepers are required. This is world history, not proof of personal participation. Dedicated servers retain hosted encounter admission; singleplayer uses native combat. The encounter owner awards eyes and trophies.
